entities.summary: Roman Empire, a political institution in Ireland during Prehistoric Ireland & Newgrange (500 BCE–400). Grew from Bronze Age Ireland and Construction of Newgrange passage tomb. Led to the emergence of Celtic Iron Age & the Gaelic World.
